objective: Reconstruct the full-field absolute acceleration response of the bridge under matched sensor-free and sensor-assisted deployment conditions.
known_at_deployment: sensor acceleration only when sensors are available
sensor_free_input: ground acceleration plus identically zero sensor values and identically zero sensor mask
sensor_assisted_input: the same ground acceleration plus sparse absolute sensor acceleration and its availability mask
primary_evaluation: all 148 unobserved nodes, with per-direction metrics
secondary_evaluation: waveform, phase, peak amplitude and peak-time metrics

target_thresholds.physical_rmse: <0.1 for X/Y/Z on the primary unobserved-node evaluation
target_thresholds.correlation: >0.9 for X/Y/Z on the primary unobserved-node evaluation
target_thresholds.sensor_value: B1 must beat matched B0 on at least 65 percent of external records
target_thresholds.robustness: improvement should be directionally consistent over at least three seeds

data_policy.development_split: deterministic hash split within the 549 training records
data_policy.external_evaluation_split: 157 historical validation records; report only, not a pristine final test
data_policy.formal_test_split: 78 untouched records; evaluate only after checkpoint and strategy selection are frozen

fairness_invariants: B0 and B1 use identical architecture, parameter count, loss profile, selector, data split, optimizer budget and seed
only sensor values and availability mask differ between B0 and B1
observed sensor rows are excluded from the primary metric
the full 153 by 1000 output is retained
physics-proxy terms may use supervised truth only during training and never at deployment

physics_boundary.available_now: temporal derivative, frequency phase, spatial-neighbor consistency, sensor self-consistency and direction balance
physics_boundary.not_available_now: complete mass, damping and stiffness matrices or a validated FE reduced-order model
physics_boundary.rule: Do not call the current proxy loss a full FE equilibrium residual; replace or extend it only after matrices/modal data are supplied.

forbidden: using unobserved response truth as model input
using historical validation truth for training or checkpoint selection
selecting only favorable earthquakes, nodes, directions or seeds
reducing the output to only pier or sensor nodes
overwriting retained baseline checkpoints or completed immutable cases
